statement: Remote work is better for productivity than office work
caseFor: Flexible schedules can protect focus time, skip exhausting commutes, and shape an environment that suits the work.
caseAgainst: Shared rooms make collaboration immediate, create useful rituals, and help teams solve fuzzy problems together.

statement: Casual dating is worth the emotional investment
caseFor: Low-pressure connections can help people learn what they want and enjoy companionship without rushing into a label.
caseAgainst: Ambiguity can make expectations harder to manage when feelings deepen at different speeds.

statement: AI can replace doctors for most everyday care
caseFor: AI can spot patterns quickly, expand access to basic guidance, and support clinicians with tireless analysis.
caseAgainst: Care is more than pattern matching: context, trust, physical examination, and accountability need a human relationship.

statement: Animals have a sense of right and wrong
caseFor: Cooperation, empathy, and fairness-like behavior appear across many social species.
caseAgainst: Human morality includes abstract rules and reflection that may not map cleanly onto animal behavior.

statement: A four-day workweek should become the standard
caseFor: A shorter week can reward focused work, improve wellbeing, and make room for life outside the job.
caseAgainst: Some customers need five-day coverage, and compressed schedules can quietly make each day longer.

statement: Social media companies should be responsible for user content
caseFor: Platforms shape reach and incentives, so thoughtful moderation can reduce preventable harm at scale.
caseAgainst: Broad liability could encourage over-removal and give private companies too much power over public conversation.

statement: Parents should set strict daily screen-time limits
caseFor: Clear limits can protect sleep, attention, and time for offline relationships.
caseAgainst: What children do on screens matters as much as how long they are there, and flexibility fits real family life better.

statement: Plastic surgery makes people more attractive
caseFor: Some procedures can align appearance with personal taste and help people feel more at home in their bodies.
caseAgainst: Attractiveness is subjective, and cultural pressure can make a personal choice feel less free than it appears.
